decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at E595-06 (radio and CMMS agree), and the likely repair is 13:20. That stope holds 260 t at 15.4 g/t, about 129 oz. Este trucks move 72 t/h against 36 t/h inflow, so an extra loader fits. LH-06 (LH514, 42 t/h) takes 0.49 h to get there and clears the 260 t in about 6.2 h, finishing before 17:00. Central is truck-limited (159 t/h inflow against 91 t/h haulage, 257 t already in the stockpile), and C564-01 is its lowest-grade stope (5.8 g/t), so taking LH-06 costs almost nothing. I did not take LH-08 or LH-09 from development because that costs 1.9 and 4.0 oz per hour. No reserve is activated because no stope was stopped.

Keep LH-06 at E595-06 (15.4 g/t, 235 t, Este already truck-limited, so no second loader there). LH-02 is down at C512-04 (13 g/t, 296 t) until 15:00-17:00. LH-10 leaves preventive maintenance at 11:00 and has no development cost. It arrives about 11:34 and loads about 5.4 h at 25.4 t/h, roughly 137 t or 57 oz. Taking LH-08 from DS-C512-01 would cost 1.9 oz/h and add little, so I leave it in place. Central has truck headroom.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
